REFER-YOUNG-DRIVER.why: The youngest driver is under 21 on the start date.
REFER-YOUNG-DRIVER.change: Check the driver's date of birth, or name an older main driver.

REFER-OLD-VEHICLE.why: The vehicle is more than 20 years old (from its year of first registration).
REFER-OLD-VEHICLE.change: Check the year of first registration.

DECLINE-UNDERAGE-DRIVER.why: The driver is under 18 on the start date.
DECLINE-UNDERAGE-DRIVER.change: Check the driver's date of birth; a driver under 18 cannot be insured.

DECLINE-CLAIMS-HISTORY.why: Five or more claims in the last five years.
DECLINE-CLAIMS-HISTORY.change: Check the number of claims in the last five years.

DECLINE-USAGE.why: Business use is not covered by the private car product.

nextStep.Open: Ask a senior underwriter to approve it (Policies › Underwriting referrals), then bind again. Or change the answer: {change}
nextStep.Rejected: A senior underwriter rejected it. Change the answer and quote again: {change}
nextStep.Invalidated: The answers changed after the approval, so it no longer applies. Ask for a new approval.

bindBlocked.title: Underwriting issues stop the bind
bindBlocked.body: The bind needs a decision on these issues first.

referrals.title: Underwriting referrals
referrals.subtitle: Referred risks waiting for a decision. Approve to let the underwriter bind; reject to stop the bind.
referrals.emptyBody: When a bind is stopped by an underwriting referral, it appears here.
referrals.reasonRequired: Enter the reason for the decision.
referrals.approved: Approved. The underwriter can bind again.
referrals.selfNote: You cannot decide a referral on a quote you created or tried to bind: another senior underwriter must decide it.
